items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Emil Carl Borg was my father’s name

ctx.x: And if we could kind of look into the past and your family history there, could you tell me your father and mother’s name?
Emil Carl Borg was my father’s name, and Arlene Anderson, before she was married, was my mother’s name. They were Swedes.
And so were they immigrants, emigrates?
